storyline.real: Mansell leads from pole until lap 71, when he feels something wrong and dives into the pits; Senna, on the set of tyres he started on, takes the lead and holds off Mansell on fresh tyres for the last laps to win by 0.215 seconds

mastery.label: Answer Mansell's fresh tyres with your own: win with one tyre stop

eras.briefing: Monaco, May 1992. Mansell has won the first five races of the year and leads from pole; Senna's McLaren started third. Your tyres have done the whole race. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times are reconstructed.

storylineCalls.real: Mansell feels something wrong (a suspected puncture or loose wheel nut) and dives into the pits at the end of lap 71, handing Senna the lead
